id.description: Stable layer identifier referenced by jobs and sessions.

kind.description: Layer type (coverage, rate, elevation, guidance, etc.).

sessionId.description: Session within the job that produced or reused the layer.

units.description: Engineering units for numeric values (e.g., gal/ac).

createdAt.description: UTC timestamp when the layer was created.

createdBy.description: Actor that produced the layer (user:*, system:*).

lastModifiedAt.description: Timestamp when layer metadata was last updated.

source.description: Originating system, plugin, or import reference.

transform.description: Transform applied to produce the layer (e.g., raw, resampled).

hash.description: Deterministic hash of the layer payload used for reuse detection.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the provenance record was generated.

actor.description: Operator or automation actor responsible for the layer change.

metadata.description: Layer-type specific metadata; structure defined by layer definitions.

attachments.description: External resources associated with the layer (tiles, rasters, documents).

extensions.description: Plugin-owned metadata complementing layer provenance (analytics rollups, profitability, etc.). Keys follow <namespace>.<topic> naming.
